entities.name: Shanodin
entities.description: Southwestern forested region on the island of Oneah in the eastern Domains, with dryads and a deadly reputation.

entities.name: Oneah
entities.description: Island containing Shanodin; its nation was destroyed by goblins.

entities.name: Heart of Shanodin
entities.description: Glade at the forest's center that reveals one's inner self.

entities.name: Davvol
entities.description: Steward who transported Shanodin villages to Rath.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane to which villages were transported.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Forest that sent Multani to investigate.

entities.name: Fall of Oneah
entities.description: Destruction of Oneah causing refugees to pass through Shanodin.

entities.name: Dryads
entities.description: Forest dwellers who reveal themselves when they wish.

events.summary: Around 3700 AR a few Shanodin villages are transported to Rath by the steward Davvol.
events.quote: a few Shanodin villages were transported to Rath by steward Davvol

events.summary: Yavimaya sends Multani to investigate the cause and effects on the forest.
events.quote: Yavimaya sent Multani to investigate the cause and effects on the forest

events.summary: After the Fall of Oneah, Oneahn refugees pass through Shanodin's woods in search of a new home.
events.quote: Shanodin saw several Oneahn refugees passing through its woods

relations.note: It is a forested region on the island.
relations.quote: Shanodin is the southwestern forested region on the island of Oneah

relations.note: It lies at the center of the forest.
relations.quote: In the center of the forest lies the Heart of Shanodin
